description: Watch and report on Datto BCDR backups: devices, agents and shares, alerts, screenshot verification, Direct-to-Cloud assets, the activity log and SaaS Protection seats.

datto_bcdr_backup_overdue_trigger.description: Runs when a backed-up machine goes longer than the hours you choose without a backup, and again each time it falls behind after catching up. Paused and archived machines are left out, and ones already overdue when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.agent: The whole agent record as Datto gives it.
output.agent_name: The machine that hasn't backed up.
output.client_name: The client the device belongs to.
output.hours_since_backup: How many hours ago that was.
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device steps.

parameters.description: Only this device. Leave empty for every device.
parameters.name: serial_number

parameters.description: Start when a machine's last backup is older than this many hours. Defaults to 24.
parameters.name: hours

datto_bcdr_new_alert_trigger.description: Runs for each new alert on a Datto BCDR device, such as a failed backup or a device that stopped checking in, on one device or every device. Alerts already open when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.alert: The whole alert as Datto gives it.
output.client_name: The client the device belongs to.
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device steps.
output.type: What the alert is about, in Datto's words.

parameters.description: Only this device. Leave empty for every device.
parameters.name: serial_number

datto_bcdr_new_device_trigger.description: Runs for each new Datto BCDR device added to your account. Devices already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.client_name: The client the device belongs to.
output.device: The whole device as Datto gives it.
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device steps.

datto_bcdr_screenshot_failed_trigger.description: Runs each time a backed-up machine fails its screenshot verification, with a link to the screenshot. Failures before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.agent: The whole agent record as Datto gives it.
output.client_name: The client the device belongs to.
output.last_backup_at: When the agent last backed up (UTC).
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device steps.

parameters.description: Only this device. Leave empty for every device.
parameters.name: serial_number
